title: Osun Grove suspension footbridge

grade.name: Osun Grove footbridge riverbanks
grade.basis: Lower the coarse standard heightfield along the mapped straight reach at the suspension footbridge. Retain the original sampled terrain beyond the grading shoulders and the standard River Osun line and surface.

limitations: The signed alignment and 31.64 m crossing endpoints come from PMTiles. The deck width, pier stations, rail spacing, cable sag and individual timber dimensions are exterior photo estimates.

The grove forest and River Osun remain native map features. Only the suspension crossing is represented by this asset. The grove palaces, shrines, gates and monuments need their own source models and reviews.
The standard Terrarium surface is nearly flat through the mapped river. The reference presentation uses a tightly bounded visualization grade in the channel. Water width and piers are approximate.
